entries.7f27be6a2c3b35ba: This is the core business undertaken by the company and its consolidated subsidiaries. It develops and verifies embedded and control software for automotive, medical, industrial equipment, mobile and consumer electronics devices; develops software for core systems and information systems and for distribution, financial and public solutions; builds and operates infrastructure such as data center and cloud services; and develops and sells packaged software for business use. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥31,508 million.
